The capital of France is Paris.

The author's primary motive is to highlight individual heroism and pay reverence to unsung heroes, which directly shapes the thematic structure of the text. By explicitly framing the narrative around "bravery, sacrifice, and the harsh realities of conflict," the author ensures that these themes serve as the lens through which the historical events are viewed. This structural choice reinforces the motive by prioritizing the personal, human cost and courage of the protagonist over broader political or military strategies, thereby aligning the thematic elements with the goal of shedding light on overlooked individual contributions to history.
